analysis.beats: 0:00-0:06: Teddy stands before ranks of identical Ichigos as the camera tracks out. 0:07-0:14: Teddy turns and walks up through the stepped crowd, taking the central spot. 0:15-0:27: The crowd of identical Ichigos rhythmically bows and rises in unison to the heavy beat while Teddy remains calm in the middle.
analysis.keyframeScene: Storybook gouache painting. Vertical framing. A massive stepped grandstand inside a cosy attic loft filled with rows of identical neat white dwarf hamsters (Ichigos). In the foreground, viewed from behind, large shaggy apricot hamster Teddy stands calmly looking up at the tiered formation. Soft warm overhead attic lighting casting gentle shadows. Solid glossy black bead eyes.
analysis.transferPrompt: Motion-transfer instructions: Ghost, the tactical character walking up through the formation and turning to face front, becomes Teddy, the large long-haired Syrian hamster. The entire surrounding crowd of SWAT soldiers in tiered rows becomes identical Ichigos (neat little white dwarf hamsters). All military gear, tactical vests, helmets, goggles, smoke, and skull masks are swapped for bare hamster fur in painterly gouache style. The crowd of Ichigos replicates the rhythmic, synchronized bowing and rising motions to the heavy chants exactly on beat. Teddy maintains his calm, deadpan stance in the center, subtly nodding to the rhythm while the camera pulls back smoothly.
analysis.caption: Ichigo organized a very dramatic morning routine rehearsal, but Teddy is mostly just waiting for breakfast.
swaps: SWAT tactical gear and helmets -> bare dwarf hamster fur
Skull mask and headset -> natural Syrian hamster face and ears
Dark military vault -> warm cosy attic loft staging

analysis.beats: 0:00-0:03 Lead locks into rhythmic footwork while crew bounces in background. 0:04-0:07 Lead executes wide arm swings and side steps. 0:08-0:12 Lead hops, glides laterally, and hits sharp poses in sync with the beat.
analysis.keyframeScene: Teddy stands centered on attic floorboards in mid-bounce, flanked by four tiny identical Ichigos hyping behind him. Sunbeams stream from a round attic window onto stacked books and potted plants in soft gouache textures.
analysis.transferPrompt: Transfer dance motions accurately. The center lead dancer becomes Teddy, a large fluffy apricot Syrian hamster with glossy black bead eyes. The surrounding backup dancers become identical Ichigos, small silvery dwarf hamsters. Maintain exact footwork, bounce timing, and camera framing. Replace human clothes with bare fur, and the concrete plaza with an attic floor.
analysis.caption: Teddy insists the footwork is second nature, provided the Ichigos keep up the hype.
swaps: Streetwear and sneakers -> bare fur and paws

analysis.beats: Teddy walks into frame in a cosy attic workshop. He flashes two colorful leaves across the lens. When lowered, an orange-and-black toy racer is revealed behind him. He smiles, gestures toward it, and climbs inside.
analysis.keyframeScene: Vertical storybook illustration. Teddy, a large shaggy apricot Syrian hamster with glossy black bead eyes, steps into the lower-right foreground. Behind him, warm lamplight illuminates an empty plank floor flanked by wooden attic pillars.
analysis.transferPrompt: The man entering frame becomes Teddy with bare apricot fur. Teddy steps close to the lens and holds up two smooth, colorful pressed leaves instead of Uno cards. When swiped away, reveal a miniature orange-and-black wooden toy racecar parked in the attic bay. Teddy smirks, gestures backward with a stubby paw, turns, walks to the toy vehicle, and climbs in. Retain identical wide-angle perspective, smooth camera motion, and timing.
analysis.caption: Teddy insists the attic racer handles like a dream, though Ichigo remains entirely unconvinced.
swaps: Uno cards -> blue and yellow painted autumn leaves
Mazda RX-7 sports car -> hand-carved orange and black toy roadster
concrete parking garage -> rustic attic workshop
